_comment: Our own cache of prebuilt llama-server binaries, for hosts/backends upstream doesn't publish (see build_cache.py, README.md's 'Building from source' section). Same shape as llama_version.json's assets section (release_base_url + tag + {key: {file, sha256}}) so fetch.py's download/verify/extract code works unchanged -- only the key format differs (see custom_asset_key in build_cache.py). This file is entirely optional: an empty assets map just falls through to a real source build every time, same as if it didn't exist.

linux-arm64-cuda-sm87.built_on: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8GB (Developer Kit Super), JetPack 6.2.3, via scripts/package_custom_build.py
